title: Celebrate Rita Marley’s 80th Birthday with Special Tributes on Bob Marley’s Tuff Gong Radio
summary: Hear exclusive premieres, live performances, and specialty shows all weekend long
body_markdown:
[Bob Marley’s Tuff Gong Radio (Ch. 19)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/tuff-gong) is celebrating Rita Marley’s 80th birthday with the “Thank You Jah 80” celebration, airing all weekend on Tuff Gong Radio and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogRitaMarleyBirthdayTuffGongRadio) .


[Bob Marley’s Tuff Gong Radio Bob’s hits, family music & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogRitaMarleyBirthdayTuffGongRadio)


The special programming honors Nana Rita with exclusive new music, live performances from members of the Marley family and acclaimed reggae artists, specialty shows, and highlights from previous birthday celebrations.


### Exclusive premiere tracks


- Rita Marley — “Strength of Adam’s Rib”
- Sheldon Shepherd — “Thank You Jah” (dub poetry tribute to Nana Rita)


### Live performances from the “Thank You Jah 80” Celebration Concert in Jamaica


- Tessanne Chin
- Nadine Sutherland
- Romain Virgo
- Alaine
- McKada


### Additional Live Performances


- Sharon Marley
- Skip Marley
- Soul-Rebel Marley
- Zion Marley


### Specialty programming


- In My House
- Tuff Classics


Listeners can also hear highlights from previous Rita Marley Birthday Concerts and birthday tributes throughout the weekend.


### “Thank You Jah 80” Broadcast Schedule


#### Bob Marley’s Tuff Gong Radio (Ch. 19)
*All times Eastern.*


**Friday, July 24**


- 11am — *In My House* with Sharon Marley: Rita Marley Tribute
- 2pm — “Love From Heart” by Delphine (from Rita Marley’s 77th Birthday Tribute)
- 5pm — “Premature Paradise” by Zion Marley (Live)
- 9pm — “Chances Are” by Skip Marley (Live)


**Saturday, July 25**


- 6am — “Don’t Waste Your Time” by Tessanne Chin (Live)
- 9am — “Stay” by Zion Marley (Live)
- 12pm — *Tuff Classics* with Collin Hines: Rita Marley Tribute
- 1pm — *In My House* with Sharon Marley
- 4pm — “Bus Dem Shut” by Soul-Rebel Marley (Live)
- 7pm — “Thank You Jah” by Sheldon Shepherd (Nana Rita tribute)
- 10pm — “News For You” by Shalom (from Rita Marley’s 79th Birthday Tribute)


**Sunday, July 26**


- 6am — “Queen” by Nadine Sutherland (Live)
- 9am — “Fade Away” by Romain Virgo (Live)
- 12pm — “Heartbeat” by Zion Marley (Live)
- 4pm — “Thank You Jah” by Sheldon Shepherd (Nana Rita tribute)
- 7pm — “No Ordinary Love” by Alaine (Live)
- 8pm — *Tuff Classics* with Collin Hines: Rita Marley Tribute
- 11pm — “6 Love Domino” by McKada (Live)
